meta.title: Pulse — Train Together. Level Up Together.
meta.description: The social fitness app where workouts become shared experiences. Build your Crew, complete live workouts, earn XP, unlock achievements and stay consistent together.

hero.subtitle: The social fitness app where workouts become shared experiences. Build your Crew, complete live workouts, earn XP, unlock achievements and stay consistent together.

socialFitness.title: This is not another workout app.
socialFitness.description: Dozens of apps promise personalized training plans. Pulse is built around a different idea — training together makes you go further.

features.title: Crew
features.description: Train with friends. Build a crew that keeps you accountable, every single day.

features.title: Party Workout
features.description: Ready together. Train together. Earn more XP when your whole crew shows up.

features.title: Live Cardio
features.description: Run, walk or cycle together in real time — no matter how far apart you are.

features.title: Feed
features.description: Share your workouts and celebrate progress with a feed built for fitness.

gamification.title: Progress that feels like a game.
gamification.description: Every workout earns XP. Every streak builds momentum. Every achievement is worth celebrating — with your Crew watching.

workoutExperience.title: Built for people who actually train.
workoutExperience.description: A premium workout UI, engineered so nothing gets between you and the next rep.

highlights.title: Personalized workout plans
highlights.description: Programs that adapt to your goals, experience and equipment — no guesswork.

highlights.title: Exercise instructions
highlights.description: Clear, guided instructions for every movement so you always train with confidence.

highlights.title: Rest timer, built in
highlights.description: Automatic rest timers between sets keep your session flowing without checking a clock.

highlights.title: Smart cardio tracking
highlights.description: Distance, pace and calories tracked precisely for outdoor and indoor cardio alike.

liveCardio.title: Train together, even when you're apart.
liveCardio.description: Run, walk or cycle in real time with your Crew — see each other's position, pace and progress as it happens.

workoutParty.title: Everyone joins. Everyone starts together.
workoutParty.description: Open a lobby, invite your Crew, and watch everyone mark themselves ready. Once the countdown hits zero, the whole party trains the same workout in sync — earning a shared XP bonus for showing up together.
steps: Players join the lobby in real time
Ready status syncs instantly across the party
A synchronized countdown starts the workout for everyone
Finishing together unlocks a shared XP bonus

feed.title: Every workout becomes a memory.
feed.description: Cardio sessions, lifting PRs, achievements, level ups, party completions — your feed captures every win worth sharing.

achievements.title: Milestones worth chasing.
achievements.description: Every badge marks a real accomplishment — and your Crew sees it the moment you unlock it.

items.quote: Party Workout changed how our whole group trains. We show up more because we know everyone else is waiting in the lobby.
items.name: Marina Souza

items.quote: Live Cardio made my morning runs social again. Racing my friends' pace in real time is way more motivating than a solo run.
items.name: Diego Ramos

items.quote: The streaks and XP kept me consistent for the first time in years. Seeing my Crew's achievements pushes me to keep going.
items.name: Kaique Alves

pricing.title: Free to start. Premium when you're ready.
pricing.description: No paywalls on what makes Pulse social. Premium is for those chasing extra performance.

plans.name: Free
plans.description: Everything needed to start training with your Crew.

plans.name: Premium
plans.description: Unlock the full depth of Pulse's training intelligence.

items.a: Open a lobby, invite your Crew, and everyone marks themselves ready. Once the countdown ends, the whole party starts the same workout together and earns a shared XP bonus for finishing as a group.
Absolutely. Every feature — personalized plans, cardio tracking, achievements — works solo. Social features like Crew, Party Workout and Live Cardio are there whenever you want them.
Start a run, walk or ride and invite your Crew to join in real time. You'll see each other's position, pace and progress on a shared live map until the session ends.
Smartwatch and wearable integrations are on our roadmap. For now, Pulse tracks your sessions precisely using your phone's GPS and sensors.
Yes. All social and gamification features — Crew, Party Workout, Live Cardio, XP, streaks and achievements — are free. Premium adds AI plan improvements and advanced analytics.
